sourceTextExcerpts.text: He brought the tribe of Benjamin near by their families and the family of the Matrites was chosen. Then Saul the son of Kish was chosen; but when they looked for him, he could not be found.

wikipediaRead.locator: Wikipedia article search for Matri/Matrites; no source-body entry that identifies the 1 Samuel 10:21 clan was verified.
wikipediaRead.identityBasisJa: 本文はfamily of the Matritesと記す。該当する集団の人物記事を確認できない。

occurrenceAudit.reasonJa: 「マトリ人の家族」という集団用法を個人名として扱わない。
